title: Screenshot just part of your screen in 1 second! ✂️⚡ #Shorts
description:
Need only one part of your screen? Don't capture everything, snip exactly what you need and paste it anywhere! 🙌

⌨️ Windows: Win + Shift + S, then drag to select (paste with Ctrl + V)
🍎 Mac: Cmd + Shift + 4, then drag to select (add Ctrl to copy to clipboard instead of saving a file)

On Windows the snip is copied to your clipboard, so you can paste it straight into a chat, email or document.

A new life-saving tip every day, in 15 seconds. Save this for later and subscribe 🔔
